lead_raw_text:
The structure of U2Hg8Au4 (reduced formula UHg4Au2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group Cm (No. 8) with 14 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies two main environments for Au, one with 10 geometric neighbors (2 Au, 6 Hg, 2 U) and one with 5 Hg neighbors, while Hg centers are coordinated by 7 or 8 neighbors, and U centers by 10 neighbors (8 Hg, 2 U). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Au–Hg polyhedra sharing corners and edges, and Hg–U polyhedra sharing corners and faces.
